messages.subject: Executive Value Proposition | DP World | Government Relations, ESG & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Mirza,

I am writing to share a strategic value proposition prepared specifically for DP World as the Group continues to expand its integrated trade, logistics and infrastructure platform across the UAE and international growth markets.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department, at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory within a capital-intensive multinational operating environment. I work across public institutions, communities, technical teams and senior management to convert external expectations into accountable execution.

DP World's current direction is particularly relevant to my experience. The Group is expanding major concessions and gateway infrastructure, strengthening cross-border trade corridors, integrating sustainability into operating performance and working closely with governments across growth markets. My background brings practical experience at the point where investment, regulation, public-sector relationships, ESG commitments and operating delivery meet.

Rather than send a conventional CV alone, I have attached a DP World-specific strategic value brief. It identifies five areas where my experience could support the Group, including government and concession stakeholder architecture, emerging-market execution, ESG evidence and decarbonisation governance, strategic partnerships, and executive issues management. It also includes a 90-180 day action framework and my three-page executive CV.

Given your senior role in DP World's external positioning, I would value your perspective on where this profile may fit best. If another executive owns the relevant mandate across Government Relations, Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships or international market execution, I would appreciate your guidance or internal referral.

Kind regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc., Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
+592 608 4735
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposition for DP World
strategic_brief.executive_summary: DP World is scaling an integrated global trade and logistics platform while navigating geopolitical disruption, changing trade corridors, government concession environments, decarbonisation expectations and increasingly complex stakeholder requirements. My value proposition is to strengthen the institutional layer that connects these priorities to execution. As Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I lead country-facing government and regulatory relations, ESG and social responsibility coordination, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory in a capital-intensive multinational operating environment. I would bring DP World a practical combination of government-interface leadership, ESG evidence discipline, cross-functional coordination and executive issue management that is relevant to new concessions, emerging-market growth, strategic partnerships, sustainable infrastructure and the long-term licence to operate around major assets.
strategic_brief.company_context: DP World reported record 2025 revenue of US$24.4 billion and adjusted EBITDA of US$6.4 billion, with 93.4 million TEU of gross throughput and US$3.1 billion of capital expenditure. Its 2026 investment programme remains focused on priority infrastructure across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, India, the United Kingdom, Senegal and other growth markets. In the first half of 2026, revenue reached US$12.7 billion despite major disruption to Middle East trade flows, while the Group continued to expand inland connectivity and invest in resilient trade infrastructure. DP World is also accelerating sustainability execution through EcoRoute, renewable electricity, lower-emission logistics and emissions-measurement tools. Its July 2026 agreement to develop two new terminals in Fujairah under a 50-year concession illustrates the scale of government, regulatory, infrastructure and stakeholder coordination embedded in the Group's growth model. This creates a strong need for leaders who translate external relationships, ESG expectations and institutional dependencies into disciplined operating action.

opportunities.title: Government and Concession Stakeholder Architecture
opportunities.rationale: DP World's global expansion depends on long-duration concessions, public-private partnerships, port authorities, customs agencies, investment bodies, regulators and national or local governments. The quality of those institutional relationships influences approvals, project sequencing, operating continuity, reputation and future investment opportunities. A consistent stakeholder architecture across priority markets would give executives clearer visibility of decision pathways, commitments, institutional expectations and emerging issues before they affect project delivery or asset performance.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would map decision-makers, regulatory dependencies, concession-related stakeholders and engagement ownership across selected markets, then establish concise executive briefs, relationship plans, commitment trackers and escalation routes. My current role applies this discipline across mining, environment, energy, aviation, labour, taxation, standards, trade and investment interfaces where external decisions directly affect operations.

opportunities.title: Emerging Market Country Readiness
opportunities.rationale: DP World's growth across Africa, the Middle East, Asia and Latin America requires operating models that combine global standards with local institutional knowledge. New terminals, logistics platforms and economic zones often bring permitting, local-content, workforce, community, environmental and government expectations that sit outside the core commercial case. Integrating those factors earlier into market-entry and expansion decisions would improve execution readiness and reduce avoidable friction after capital commitments are made.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would build a practical country-readiness framework for selected expansion markets, combining government relations, regulatory mapping, ESG obligations, stakeholder analysis, local-partner considerations, social-performance risks and implementation ownership. My experience inside a multinational mining group gives me direct exposure to aligning global corporate requirements with country-level institutions and operating realities.

opportunities.title: ESG Evidence and Decarbonisation Governance
opportunities.rationale: DP World is linking operational efficiency and commercial value with decarbonisation through renewable electricity, lower-carbon transport, carbon insetting, emissions measurement and customer solutions such as EcoRoute. As programmes scale across assets and jurisdictions, executive confidence depends on traceable data, accountable owners, consistent governance and credible stakeholder communication. Strong evidence systems also support regulatory readiness, customer trust, financing narratives and transparent progress against climate commitments.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would support ESG governance by connecting commitments to operating evidence, action ownership and executive reporting. I have coordinated a carbon-accounting proof of concept using physical operating records across fuel, electricity, explosives, material movement, production and refinery data, and support stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

opportunities.title: Strategic Partnerships and Trade Ecosystems
opportunities.rationale: DP World's integrated model increasingly links ports, inland logistics, special economic zones, industrial customers, governments and strategic partners. The commercial value of that model rises when institutional relationships and partnership structures support investment attraction, industrial development, trade facilitation and broader economic outcomes. This is especially important in growth markets where governments evaluate major infrastructure partners against national development, jobs, skills, local business participation and sustainability objectives alongside direct financial returns.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would help structure stakeholder and partnership plans that connect DP World's commercial objectives with government priorities, investment agencies, industry partners, workforce-development institutions and community outcomes. My current mandate combines government engagement, social performance, strategic partnerships and local economic interfaces, allowing me to translate institutional priorities into practical joint workstreams and measurable commitments.

opportunities.title: Executive Issues and Reputation Readiness
opportunities.rationale: Critical infrastructure businesses operate under sustained public, regulatory and media scrutiny. Trade disruptions, permitting matters, community concerns, environmental performance, labour issues and government commitments often require coordinated responses across operations, legal, sustainability, communications and senior management. A disciplined issues-management approach helps leadership separate signal from noise, establish the factual record, identify accountable owners and respond before operational matters develop into larger institutional or reputation risks.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish concise executive issue briefs, stakeholder-risk registers, evidence trackers and escalation protocols for selected high-exposure matters. I routinely coordinate reputation-sensitive and regulator-facing issues across operations, HSE, environment, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security, aviation and technical teams, with emphasis on accurate facts, clear accountability and timely closure.

days_0_30: Confirm the regions, concessions, growth projects or corporate workstreams where government, ESG and stakeholder execution would create the strongest near-term value.
Map priority authorities, regulators, concession partners, investment agencies, community interfaces and internal owners against live business objectives and existing relationship coverage.
Review current stakeholder intelligence, ESG evidence, commitments and executive escalation processes to identify gaps, duplication and decision bottlenecks.
days_31_60: Select three to five priority pilots based on investment exposure, stakeholder complexity, execution risk and leadership sponsorship.
Build integrated stakeholder and country-readiness plans with clear objectives, engagement cadence, evidence requirements, internal ownership and escalation thresholds.
Create an executive dashboard covering institutional dependencies, commitments, regulatory milestones, emerging issues and strategic partnership opportunities.
days_61_90: Launch pilot engagement plans with agreed executive sponsors and concise briefing materials for priority government, regulatory and strategic-partner interactions.
Connect ESG and sustainability commitments to operating data, action owners and management review across selected assets or programmes.
Establish a structured lessons process to capture repeatable practices across concessions, markets and business units.
days_91_180: Scale effective pilot practices into a common toolkit for government relations, country readiness, stakeholder governance and executive issue management.
Measure impact through decision-cycle time, commitment closure, regulatory milestones, stakeholder outcomes, evidence quality and reduced execution friction.
Institutionalise a reporting cadence that gives leadership earlier visibility of external dependencies, partnership opportunities and reputation-sensitive matters across priority markets.

potential_impact: Earlier identification of government, regulatory and stakeholder dependencies around concessions, infrastructure investments and market expansion.
Stronger country-level execution by integrating institutional, ESG, workforce and community considerations before major project decisions are locked in.
More consistent translation of sustainability commitments into operating evidence, accountable actions and executive reporting.
Higher-quality executive decisions through concise stakeholder intelligence, issue escalation and cross-functional ownership.
A repeatable framework connecting DP World's global strategy with local institutions, partnerships and long-term operating legitimacy in growth markets.

Coordinated a 2026 carbon-accounting proof of concept linking physical operating data across fuel, electricity, explosives, material movement, production and refinery records to strengthen traceability and review readiness.
